summary: Escorted courier credential mismatch for encrypted SSD/GPU return + temporary badge and hotdesk setup for visiting contractor
description:
Issue summary: A contracted engineering vendor (Onsite Labs LLC) returned two encrypted SSDs and an external GPU chassis via an express courier. Dock team reported driver's badge and company credentials did not match the pre-authorized manifest. Security policy requires escorted handover for sealed, high-value hardware and a valid sponsor badge. The contractor also needs a one-day hotdesk and temporary badge to access Building A for device handoff and initial verification.

Impact: Assets are held at Dock 3 pending resolution. Delay prevents IT from performing intake wipe verification and beginning RMA workflows, potentially missing return deadlines with the vendor. Contractor cannot access the lab to hand over additional paperwork. No customer-facing outage, but high-value asset chain-of-custody at risk.

Location and timeline:
- Dock: Building A, Dock 3 receiving bay
- Created: 2026-03-12 09:14 PST (dock receipt)
- Courier arrival & discrepancy discovered: 2026-03-12 09:28 PST
- Current hold status: items moved to secure receiving locker 4; locked and logged.

Required actions:
1) Validate courier manifest against PO and vendor contract (Contracts & Procurement).
2) Issue one-day escorted sponsor badge to contractor (Security) or arrange sponsor escort for the courier driver.
3) Coordinate with IT Asset Management to open sealed container for serial verification and to start sanitized intake (IT Support & Inventory).
4) Reserve hotdesk 07 for contractor for 2026-03-13 morning, pre-configure docking station and monitor mounts (Facilities & IT).
5) Update shipment record and create RMA/return ticket if hardware confirmed intact (Inventory).

Attachments: scanned courier manifest, photo of shipping crate label, dock sign-in log.

Notes: This ticket requires cross-team approvals and a brief security exception for temporary badge issuance if the vendor sponsor cannot be present.
steps_to_reproduce: Dock team receives a courier manifest and package at Dock 3
Security scans courier badge and compares to pre-authorized vendor manifest
Mismatch found between driver name and manifest company; courier requests leave of assets at dock
Facilities places assets into secure locker per policy and opens this ticket for escorted handover and temporary badge request
attempted_workarounds: Onsite supervisor called vendor procurement to validate manifest (procurement confirmed valid PO but different courier operator subcontracted)
Temporary courier contact provided additional ID but security policy requires a sponsor escort or vetted badge - photo ID alone deemed insufficient
Dock team moved assets to lockbox 4 and applied tamper-evident seal
comments: Aria Kim (Security) 2026-03-12: Confirmed mismatch; vendor provided alternate driver name but no corporate ID. Per escort runbook we require either registered courier or on-site sponsor. Holding items in secure locker.

Daniel Ruiz (IT Asset Mgmt) 2026-03-12: Please do not open sealed crates until we confirm chain-of-custody. If Security approves sponsored escort we can do serial verification on-site and initiate wipe/RMA. Will prepare intake checklist.

Maya Patel (Facilities) 2026-03-12: Dock photos and scanned manifest attached to ticket. Courier company contact: expressline-apac@carrier.com, phone +1-415-555-0133. Vendor procurement confirmed contract #PO-77821.
FedEx/APAC (Courier) 2026-03-12: Driver Michael Santos (license XZ1234) was subcontracted locally. We can provide driver ID and proof-of-delivery signature; request temporary escort for handover.

Liam O'Connor (Assignee) 2026-03-12: Will coordinate with Security for sponsor badge window. Scheduling hotdesk setup for 2026-03-13 08:30-11:30. Updating ticket with ETA after procurement confirms sponsor person.

Katherine Li (Procurement) 2026-03-12: Verified PO-77821. Vendor is Onsite Labs LLC. Vendor rep (J. Ortega) confirmed they subcontracted final-mile courier due to capacity. Can provide email confirmation for escort.

Aria Kim (Security) 2026-03-13: Temporarily approved sponsor escort from Onsite Labs (J. Ortega). Issued escorted visitor pass for 2026-03-13 08:45-10:30. Security will join handover at dock and log chain-of-custody.
resolution_notes: Partial resolution on 2026-03-13: Security granted a one-day escorted visitor pass to the named vendor rep after procurement provided vendor-signed authorization. Assets were opened by IT Asset Mgmt at the secured receiving area, serials verified, and intake wipe initiated. Hotdesk 07 was reserved and pre-configured; contractor used the desk to complete paperwork. No tamper evidence found. Next steps: update RMA record and close after final ingestion into inventory system. Recommend adding subcontracted-courier clause to vendor onboarding checklist to prevent future mismatches.
follow_up_tasks: Update vendor onboarding checklist to require courier disclosures
Add subcontracted courier validation step to dock SOP
Procurement to add vendor contact field for day-of delivery confirmations
